reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added writing a status condition for binding AuthorizationPolicy to a waypoint proxy", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The formatting of AuthorizationPolicy status conditions is experimental and will change in future releases.
consequence.remediation: Review status condition formats written to AuthorizationPolicy resources and plan for format changes in upcoming releases.

proposed.statement: A status condition for binding AuthorizationPolicy to a waypoint proxy is now written to the AuthorizationPolicy status; the formatting of these conditions is experimental and will change.
